symptom: The ChatGPT recovery/polling stream timed out while the external GitHub Actions execution continued and later completed successfully.
root_cause: The conversational observation channel and the external execution lifecycle are independent; channel timeout does not terminate the external process.
early_signals: UI reported stream recovery polling timed out
GitHub Actions remained the authoritative execution source
human_cost: Operator lost live conversational visibility and had to re-enter the conversation to continue.
prevention_rule: On observation-channel loss, mark execution result INDETERMINATE in the conversation, do not restart or infer outcome, recover the durable checkpoint, and query the authoritative external source before continuing.
automated_detection: MOCATRIZ Continuity Test 02 distinguishes execution, observation, memory and resumption planes.
